name: Yuan Gonglu
source:
[i]"I made a bet. Against the heavens. And the result is Nine Gates. ...Looks like the heavens are on my side."[/i]

[i]Unparalleled Fraudster[/i]

Boss of the Yuan family. He's aloof, doesn't play far, and loves to rile up whoever he's up against.

He favors gambling and cheating. 

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/neonclash/english/characters/]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
